summary_zh: 前文称北京24小时机器人咖啡店开业，单机完成研磨冲煮出杯，等待少于30秒，首小时202杯并创吉尼斯。收录帖将话题具体到主品牌七鲜咖啡、北京银河SOHO、8月16日直播挑战及高客流体验。片段无后续回应；有助核对时间地点和品牌归属，情绪偏惊叹。

posts.text:
🇨🇳 A robot opened a 24-hour coffee shop in Beijing and immediately set a Guinness World Record.

One machine does everything: grinds, brews, pours, and serves. 

Average wait time is under 30 seconds. On opening day it pumped out 202 cups in a single hour!

Humans are officially on notice in the coffee game 👀

Writer: Sol
https://t.co/vEgMejlpal

posts.translation_zh:
🇨🇳 一台机器人在北京开了一家 24 小时咖啡店，并立即创下了吉尼斯世界纪录。

一台机器包办一切：研磨、冲煮、倒出和服务。

平均等待时间不到 30 秒。开业当天，它在短短一小时内做出了 202 杯！

在人类咖啡赛道上，警报已经正式拉响 👀

作者：Sol

posts.text: This checks out — https://t.co/ZDWkMsefBX's Qixian Coffee opened its first 24-hour intelligent unmanned coffee shop on August 16th at Galaxy Soho in Beijing, and launched a Guinness World Record attempt with a live stream on opening day [Aibase](https://t.co/3AHUXGDzuY) . Cool timing too — that's today. 30-second wait times and 200+ cups an hour is genuinely wild throughput for a single machine. Baristas aren't going extinct, but late-night/high-volume shifts might be the first to feel it. ☕🤖
